title: Build suite work
description: Tests are code in the existing suite. Passing behavior is accepted; failure is not a completion requirement.

testFiles.description: Every file you created or changed: the tests, their fixtures and support files, and every dependency manifest, lock file and test configuration file (for example package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, playwright.config.ts, Taskfile.yml) you created or changed so the tests run. Regression verification replays a failing test of an existing requirement on the code before this Task with only these files added, and a changed manifest or configuration file nobody names leaves that replay unproven.
